overall_goal: Prepare the yogurt sauce by combining and mixing all the required ingredients in a bowl

goals.description: Wash and dry the mixing bowl
goals.rationale: The person rinses the bowl with water and dries it with a cloth to prepare it for mixing ingredients.

goals.description: Set up the workspace and gather ingredients
goals.rationale: The person places the bowl on the weighing scale and retrieves the necessary ingredients like yogurt, Sriracha, salt, and pepper.

goals.description: Add yogurt to the mixing bowl
goals.rationale: The person opens the yogurt container and scoops multiple spoonfuls of yogurt into the bowl on the scale.

goals.description: Add Sriracha sauce to the mixing bowl
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a fresh spoon and uses it to measure and add Sriracha sauce to the yogurt.

goals.description: Add salt and pepper to the mixing bowl
goals.rationale: The person gets another spoon and adds measured amounts of pink salt and ground pepper to the mixture.

goals.description: Open and add parsley to the mixing bowl
goals.rationale: The person removes the plastic seal from the parsley jar, opens it, and taps parsley into the bowl.

goals.description: Prepare and add lemon juice to the mixing bowl
goals.rationale: The person cuts a lemon, removes its seeds, and squeezes the juice into the sauce mixture.
The person stirs the combined ingredients in the bowl to create a smooth and uniform sauce.
